strings.zh: 城都地区传说中的{NEWLINE}海洋守护神洛奇亚,{CLEAR}是一只银白色的大鸟,{CLEAR}它只要扇动一下翅膀,{CLEAR}就能引起持续40天的暴风雨。{CLEAR}洛奇亚因为害怕{CLEAR}自身强大的力量伤害到人类,{CLEAR}于是选择了到海底隐居。{SCROLL}据说从浅葱市到湛蓝市{NEWLINE}之间的4座海岛,{CLEAR}就是洛奇亚隐居的地方。
strings.en: Johto’s legendary guardian of{NEWLINE}the seas, Lugia, is a great silver-white{CLEAR}bird. With a single beat of its wings, it{CLEAR}can stir up a storm that lasts 40 days.{SCROLL}Lugia feared its own mighty power{NEWLINE}would hurt people, so it chose to{CLEAR}live hidden at the bottom of the sea.{SCROLL}They say the 4 islands between{NEWLINE}Olivine City and Cianwood City{CLEAR}are where Lugia lives in hiding.

strings.zh: 等我有了水系精灵,{NEWLINE}就去跟隔壁的大哥哥{CLEAR}学习旋涡技能。{CLEAR}然后就可以去漩涡列岛的最深处,{CLEAR}拜访一下海神大人了。
strings.en: When I get a Water-type{NEWLINE}Pokémon, I’ll learn Whirlpool{CLEAR}from the big brother next door.{SCROLL}Then I can go to the deepest{NEWLINE}part of the Whirl Islands and pay{CLEAR}a visit to the god of the sea.

strings.zh: 我从姐姐那里{NEWLINE}得到了很多的贴纸！{CLEAR}分给你一点吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: My sister gave me a lot of Seals!{CLEAR}Here, have some!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 好棒！{NEWLINE}有好多贴纸呢！{SCROLL}可以贴{NEWLINE}好多的球呢！
strings.en: Wow!{NEWLINE}You have so many Seals!{SCROLL}You can cover your Poké Balls in Seals!

strings.zh: 到了明天,{NEWLINE}我会给你更好的！
strings.en: I can give you better ones tomorrow!

strings.zh: 咦？你没有贴纸盒么？{SCROLL}我听说39号路的哞哞农场那边{NEWLINE}也有人在收集贴纸,{CLEAR}你如果想要贴纸盒,{CLEAR}可以去哞哞农场碰碰运气。
strings.en: Huh? You don’t have a Seal Case?{SCROLL}I heard someone at MooMoo{NEWLINE}Farm on Route 39 collects Seals{CLEAR}too. If you want a Seal Case,{CLEAR}try your luck at MooMoo Farm.

strings.zh: 那……{NEWLINE}这张给你！{SCROLL}
strings.en: There!{NEWLINE}I’ll give you this!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 再给你{NEWLINE}一张吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Have another!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 还有还有,{NEWLINE}拿着！{SCROLL}
strings.en: And more! Here, take these!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0609/8 | RV042: omission: 还有还有, 拿着！

strings.zh: 把贴纸轻轻地{NEWLINE}贴在球上！
strings.en: Stick the Seals gently on your Balls!
strings.notes: US 0609/9 | RV042: meaning: zh: stick Seals gently on the Balls, not on Ball Capsules

strings.zh: 哇！你的贴纸{NEWLINE}已经满了啊！
strings.en: Whoa! Your Seal Case is already full!
strings.notes: US 0609/10 | RV042: omission: 哇 and 已经 dropped

strings.zh: 把{VAR:010A:0}{NEWLINE}放入了贴纸盒中！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The {VAR:010A:0} was{NEWLINE}put away in the Seal Case.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我的父亲和爷爷{NEWLINE}都是研究水系精灵生态的专家,{CLEAR}我也梦想跟他们一样{CLEAR}能成这方面的专家。{CLEAR}但是我小时候有一次{CLEAR}被铁炮鱼撞到海里差点淹死,{CLEAR}从那之后我就非常惧怕靠近大海。{SCROLL}医生说要我多跟{NEWLINE}身体含水量高的精灵接触,{CLEAR}如果感到恐惧,{CLEAR}接触的时候就穿上防水服,{CLEAR}通过这种方式一步一步消除心理障碍。{SCROLL}可是我都不敢靠近水边{NEWLINE}哪里去弄水系精灵啊。{CLEAR}而且防水服这种东西我也没有……
strings.en: My father and grandfather were both{NEWLINE}experts who studied Water-type{CLEAR}Pokémon in the wild, and I dream{CLEAR}of becoming an expert like them.{SCROLL}But when I was little, a Remoraid{NEWLINE}knocked me into the sea and I nearly{CLEAR}drowned. Ever since, I’ve been{CLEAR}terrified of going near the sea.{SCROLL}My doctor told me to spend{NEWLINE}lots of time with Pokémon{CLEAR}whose bodies are full of water.{SCROLL}If I feel scared, I should wear a{NEWLINE}Diving Suit while I’m with them, and{CLEAR}get over my fear step by step.{SCROLL}But I don’t even dare go near the{NEWLINE}water, so how am I supposed to{CLEAR}get a Water-type Pokémon? And I{CLEAR}don’t have a Diving Suit either...

strings.zh: 要把玛瑙水母和防水服送给他吗？
strings.en: Give him Tentacool and the Diving Suit?
strings.notes: 玛瑙水母 → Tentacool (glossary); 防水服 → Diving Suit (digest).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我这里有一只玛瑙水母{NEWLINE}和一套防水服,{CLEAR}如果你需要的话就送给你吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ve got a Tentacool{NEWLINE}and a Diving Suit here. If you{CLEAR}need them, they’re yours.

strings.zh: 啊,这确实是我需要的{NEWLINE}精灵和防水服！{CLEAR}就这么送给我了……？{CLEAR}真的是太感谢你了！
strings.en: Ah, that’s exactly the Pokémon{NEWLINE}and suit I need! You’re just giving{CLEAR}them to me...? Thank you so much!

strings.zh: 我也不能白拿你的东西,{NEWLINE}这个是研究水系精灵时{CLEAR}必不可少的技能机「旋涡」,{CLEAR}就送给你当做谢礼吧。
strings.en: I can’t take your things{NEWLINE}for nothing. This is TM Whirlpool, a{CLEAR}must-have for studying Water-type{CLEAR}Pokémon. Please take it as thanks.

strings.zh: 哎？玛瑙水母？在哪呢？
strings.en: Huh? A Tentacool? Where?

strings.zh: 呃……抱歉是我听错了,{NEWLINE}原来不是要送我玛瑙水母啊。
strings.en: Uh... Sorry, I misheard. So you{NEWLINE}weren’t giving me a Tentacool after all.

strings.zh: 这不是个精灵蛋吗？
strings.en: Isn’t this a Pokémon Egg?

strings.zh: 你这个不是玛瑙水母啊……
strings.en: That’s not a Tentacool...

strings.zh: ……哎呀{NEWLINE}那这样你的精灵{CLEAR}就会１只都不剩了哦！
strings.en: ...Oh dear, then you wouldn’t have a{NEWLINE}single Pokémon left!
strings.notes: Same zh as 0130 #154; copied (v3 line replaced).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}把玛瑙水母送出去了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} handed over Tentacool!

strings.zh: 玛瑙水母『Teee——ta！
strings.en: Tentacool: Teee-ta!

strings.zh: 多谢你送来的玛瑙水母和防水服,{NEWLINE}我感觉现在已经能{CLEAR}慢慢接近水系精灵了。
strings.en: Thanks for the Tentacool and the{NEWLINE}Diving Suit. I feel like I can slowly get{CLEAR}closer to Water-type Pokémon now.

strings.zh: 我经常出海钓鱼,{NEWLINE}有时候一钓就是好几天。{CLEAR}妻子每次都为我准备好丰盛的盒饭。{SCROLL}我很感谢妻子对我钓鱼事业的支持,{NEWLINE}所以我想为妻子准备一桌{CLEAR}丰盛的晚餐表达我的谢意。{CLEAR}但是真到自己动手的时候,{CLEAR}却发现平时的饭都是妻子在做,{CLEAR}我根本不会做饭……{SCROLL}你要是会做饭的话,{NEWLINE}能教我几个菜吗？{CLEAR}也不用教太多,{CLEAR}就主食、素材、肉菜各一种就行。
strings.en: I often go out to sea to fish,{NEWLINE}sometimes for days at a time. My{CLEAR}wife always packs me a hearty lunch.{SCROLL}I’m so grateful for how she{NEWLINE}supports my fishing, so I want to{CLEAR}make her a big dinner to thank her.{SCROLL}But when I actually tried, I{NEWLINE}realized she’s always done the{CLEAR}cooking. I can’t cook at all...{SCROLL}If you know how to cook, could{NEWLINE}you teach me a few dishes? Not{CLEAR}too many. Just one staple, one{CLEAR}veggie dish and one meat dish.
strings.notes: zh 素材 read as a typo for 素菜 (vegetable dish).

strings.zh: 我也不会做菜……
strings.en: I can’t cook either...
strings.notes: Menu: player's three answers (#26 can't cook, #27 not that many dishes, #28 learned a few → #31–#36).

strings.zh: 我不会这么多种类的菜
strings.en: Not that many dishes

strings.zh: 我刚学了几个菜
strings.en: I just learned a few

strings.zh: 好吧,做菜是挺难的。
strings.en: Well, OK. Cooking is pretty hard.

strings.zh: 我老公说要给我做一桌丰盛的晚餐{NEWLINE}表示对我的感谢。{CLEAR}其实只要能看到{CLEAR}他为自己的事业忙碌、开心,{CLEAR}我就很满足了。
strings.en: My husband says he’s going to{NEWLINE}cook me a big dinner to thank me.{SCROLL}Honestly, just seeing him busy and{NEWLINE}happy with his work is enough for me.

strings.zh: 你会做这么多种菜？{NEWLINE}快,快教教我！
strings.en: You know how to cook that{NEWLINE}many dishes? Quick, teach me!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『啊,是这样的。{NEWLINE}首先是饼卷大葱,{CLEAR}饼的厚薄、葱的白绿、料的咸淡{CLEAR}这几个方面都很重要……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Ah, OK, here goes.{NEWLINE}First, scallion pancake wraps.{SCROLL}The thickness of the pancake, the white{NEWLINE}and green of the scallion, how salty{CLEAR}the sauce is... All of it matters...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『然后是素食拔丝大树果,{NEWLINE}糖汁里加蜂蜜会使味道更甜美,{CLEAR}但也更考验火候……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Next, candied Sitrus Berries,{NEWLINE}a vegetarian dish. Adding Honey to{CLEAR}the syrup makes it sweeter, but you{CLEAR}really have to watch the heat...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『最后是铁板五花肉,{NEWLINE}将腌好的五花肉{CLEAR}铺在滚烫的铁板上,{CLEAR}铁板的温度越高,{CLEAR}肉就要切得越厚……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Last, sizzling pork{NEWLINE}belly. Lay the marinated pork{CLEAR}belly on a piping-hot iron griddle.{SCROLL}The hotter the griddle, the thicker{NEWLINE}you need to slice the meat...

strings.zh: 原来菜是这么做的啊！{NEWLINE}学到了,学到了。
strings.en: So that’s how you make{NEWLINE}them! I’ve learned so much.

strings.zh: 谢谢你教给我这么多做菜的技巧。{NEWLINE}我这里有根高级钓竿,{CLEAR}能钓上普通钓竿钓不到的精灵,{CLEAR}我把它送给你,{CLEAR}就当做是这次教学的学费吧。
strings.en: Thanks for teaching me{NEWLINE}so many cooking tips.{SCROLL}I’ve got a Super Rod here that can{NEWLINE}hook Pokémon a regular rod can’t.{CLEAR}Take it as payment for the lessons.

strings.zh: 跟你学了这么多做菜技巧,{NEWLINE}我的厨艺大有长进呐,哈哈哈。
strings.en: After all those cooking tips you{NEWLINE}taught me, my cooking’s gotten{CLEAR}a whole lot better, ha ha ha.

strings.zh: 我丈夫最近开始研究做饭了,{NEWLINE}还挺有模有样的。
strings.en: My husband recently started{NEWLINE}getting into cooking. He’s{CLEAR}actually pretty good at it.

strings.zh: 最近每次出海都能钓到大鱼,{NEWLINE}照这个势头下去,{CLEAR}一定能在钓鱼比赛上拿奖。
strings.en: I’ve been catching big fish{NEWLINE}every time I go out lately. At{CLEAR}this rate, I’ll definitely win a{CLEAR}prize at the fishing contest.

strings.zh: 每次我老公出海钓回大鱼来,{NEWLINE}我都会用这条鱼做一道菜,{CLEAR}以此来庆祝他这一天取得的成果。
strings.en: Every time my husband comes home{NEWLINE}with a big fish, I make a dish with{CLEAR}it to celebrate how his day went.
